[[Rage Maulhoof]] is a [[Forest Minotaur]] [[boss]] that appears in [[The Black Curtain]].

*[[Forest Minotaur Hide]]
*[[Forest Minotaur Horn]]

== Notes ==
*This boss is one of six that the [[Krytan Herald]] at the [[Temple of the Ages]] warns about. All six bosses have levels that are much higher than the other foes in the area.
*Rage has about a 50% chance to spawn per instance, and does so alongside two normal Forest Minotaurs.  If he doesn't spawn, three normal Forest Minotaurs spawn instead.
*While engaged with Rage and his group, be wary as more Forest Minotaurs may run in from the west.
